parsed.summary: Quality Bulletin QB-368 reported lot LOT-0191 of CHIP-IVI from supplier SUP-12 installed at P_IN on vehicles built from 2027-03-02 to 2027-03-03 had a faulty weld. The supply-chain control tower placed the lot on hold, stopped the sale of unsold vehicles, and contacted owners.
parsed.decision_reason: Acted on a real incident under rule quality_hold because the ids and dates resolved against the data, the rehearsal on the digital twin passed with zero failures, and the live schedule baseline matched before the first write.
